svg.title: Figure 09 · Nelson–Siegel factor loadings
svg.desc: Decay time τ = 1.6 years. The zero curvature loading peaks near 1.793τ; the forward curvature loading peaks at τ. The coefficients have rate units and the loadings are dimensionless.
